RED, compile stage (measured in a separate probe tree, never the lane). An open-ended peer is not evidence of compatibility. G6: frontend/app/app.module.ts:122 writes a webpack inline loader chain, require(`raw-loader!../translate/messages.${locale}.xlf`); raw-loader@1.0.0 was an undeclared transitive of devkit 0.801.2 and devkit 16.2 does not ship it. G7: overlay.service.ts:27 msOverflowStyle left lib.dom.d.ts between TS 3.4.5 and 5.1.3.

SHARPEST FINDING (G5), and the one that is a wiring defect rather than a knowledge gap: packages/frameworks/angular/src/module-with-providers-type-argument.ts and unparameterised-base-class.ts are exported from the package index and imported by NOTHING inside the package. migrateAngularCliEraWorkspace imports thirteen capability modules and neither is among them, so the composed changeset can never run them for any application.
